method: Full reads of two pinned sources; verified Git blob and SHA256. Compiled unchanged SHA3 C implementation with authored vectors generated independently by Python hashlib.
findings: SHA3 context maintains saved partial word, byte/word indices and capacity; Init clears full context and selects256/384/512 capacity. Header does not include stdint/stddef itself despite using their types, so caller include order matters.

Update assembles little-endian64-bit words explicitly and carries partial words across updates. Finalize applies SHA3 suffix unless SHA3_USE_KECCAK is enabled, performs final permutation and serializes state bytes little-endian.

Finalize mutates context and returns pointer into context-owned output. It is not a const repeatable finalization contract like BLAKE3/Cat HighwayHash. SHA3_ASSERT macro is empty in pinned header, so internal conditions are not runtime guards.

executed_control.scope: Independent expected digests for deterministic byte payloads, empty input, word and sponge-rate boundaries, repeated update. Current host only; no big-endian/32-bit, Keccak mode or performance qualification.
